title: Profile images that read as trust
purpose: A sharp banner and headshot, graded to match: the first trust signal.
why: A recruiter decides in seconds. Sharp, consistent images are the first trust signal before a word is read.
evidence: Both images live on your profile.

tasks.title: New banner: high resolution, colors that read as trust
tasks.done_when: The banner is live and matches the headshot's color grade.

tasks.title: New headshot: camera further back, dressed for the seat you want, graded to match the banner
tasks.done_when: The headshot is live and shows your shoulders, not just a face.
